setup: apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends build-essential git ca-certificates postgresql-client inotify-tools
warmup: mix local.hex --force && mix local.rebar --force && mix deps.get --check-locked
mix compile && mix do esbuild.install --if-missing + tailwind.install --if-missing + generate_lumis_css
install: mix local.hex --force && mix local.rebar --force && mix deps.get --check-locked
mix compile && mix do esbuild.install --if-missing + tailwind.install --if-missing + generate_lumis_css

mkdir -p tmp/homemade && printf '%s\n' 'import Config' 'import_config "../../config/config.exs"' 'base = System.fetch_env!("APP_URL") |> String.trim_trailing("/")' 'uri = URI.parse(base)' 'config :hexpm, host: uri.host, cdn_url: base, email_base_url: base, img_url: base <> "/img", docs_url: base, private_docs_url: base, readme_host: uri.host, readme_url: base' 'config :hexpm, HexpmWeb.Endpoint, http: [ip: {0, 0, 0, 0}, port: String.to_integer(System.get_env("PORT", "4000"))], url: [scheme: uri.scheme, host: uri.host, port: uri.port], secret_key_base: Base.encode64(:crypto.hash(:sha512, System.fetch_env!("SECRET_KEY_BASE"))), check_origin: false' > tmp/homemade/dev.exs

web.cmd: timeout 120 sh -c 'until pg_isready -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5432 -U postgres -q; do sleep 1; done' && mix do loadconfig tmp/homemade/dev.exs + ecto.create + ecto.load --skip-if-loaded + ecto.migrate + run -e 'unless Hexpm.Repo.get_by(Hexpm.Accounts.User, username: "eric"), do: Code.eval_file("priv/repo/seeds.exs")' && exec mix do loadconfig tmp/homemade/dev.exs + phx.server
